title: When Identity Skews Debate: Anonymization for Bias-Reduced Multi-Agent Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying an LLM agent's tendency to align with a peer's prior answer (Conformity/Sycophancy) versus adhering to its own prior answer (Obstinacy/Self-bias) during multi-agent debates, formalized through an Identity Bias Coefficient (IBC) metric and evaluated by comparing standard debate prompts with anonymized prompts.
